mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, student_no, name, gender, age, class_name, major, college, phone, email, address, create_time, update_time FROM student

SELECT id, user_id, student_no, name, gender, age, class_name, major, college, phone, email, address, create_time, update_time FROM student
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{studentNo}, '%')
AND major LIKE CONCAT('%', #{major}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (user_id, student_no, name, gender, age, class_name, major, college, phone, email, address, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{studentNo}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{className}, #{major}, #{college}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{address}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
